scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to show empathy at [02:50] when customer expressed acute physical pain and distress from arthritis when unable to use voice search.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to paraphrase customer's voice remote failure in own words.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Asked customer at [07:15] for her TV box model which had already been verified at [00:45].

grader.scenario: TV voice remote Bluetooth pairing failure and dead microphone after firmware patch
grader.notes: Good technical walk-through of Bluetooth voice remote pairing, but agent failed empathy regarding physical arthritis pain, failed paraphrasing, and repeated a question about TV box model.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net TV support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Fiona throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer expressed acute distress and joint pain from severe arthritis; agent offered no empathy and recited Bluetooth protocols.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the voice remote failure in his own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for TV box model at turn 26 despite customer providing S-Net 4K Hub Box at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent guided customer through Bluetooth re-pairing sequence to successfully restore voice commands.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained a courteous instructional tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked diagnostic questions regarding remote LED behavior and button responses.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed voice remote paired, tuned to BBC One, and opened recordings via voice.
